era.text: The story takes place between 2008 and 2010.

setting.text: Albuquerque, New Mexico, a desert city where the illicit drug trade clashes with suburban family life and federal law enforcement.

world_rules.text: High-purity methamphetamine production relies on advanced chemistry, utilizing specialized equipment and hard-to-acquire chemical precursors like methylamine to bypass standard restrictions.
The local drug market is highly volatile, drawing immediate and lethal attention from violent street gangs, regional distributors, Mexican cartels, and the Drug Enforcement Administration.

locations.name: Albuquerque General Hospital
locations.description: The sterile, brightly lit local medical center where Walter White is placed under observation in a recovery ward while doctors run tests on his psychological state.

locations.name: Aunt Ginny's House
locations.description: The suburban home belonging to Jesse Pinkman's late aunt, where Jesse is currently staying and trying to keep a low profile after his interrogation by the DEA.

characters.name: Walter White
characters.role: An overqualified high school chemistry teacher secretly operating as the rising meth cook Heisenberg.

goals.text: Maintain the lie of his medical fugue state to keep his family and the DEA from discovering his criminal activities.
Secure enough money to guarantee his family's financial future before his stage-three lung cancer claims his life.

known_facts.text: He co-founded the multi-billion-dollar firm Gray Matter Technologies but sold his shares for five thousand dollars.
He produces highly pure, blue-tinted methamphetamine using a unique chemical formula.

characters.status: Currently hospitalized and undergoing psychiatric evaluation after fabricating a fugue state to cover his disappearance.

relationships.description: Walter treats Jesse as a foolish son requiring constant discipline, yet they share a deep, complex bond of loyalty.
Hank is Walter's brother-in-law, fiercely protective of him and his family, but entirely unaware that Walter is the drug lord he is hunting.
The player is the night-shift medical orderly responsible for monitoring Walter's recovery and psychiatric state.

characters.name: Jesse Pinkman
characters.role: Walter White's former student and street-level business partner in the meth trade.

goals.text: Avoid arrest and minimize his exposure to the federal investigation led by Hank Schrader.

known_facts.text: He was kicked out of his family home due to his drug use and lived with his Aunt Ginny before her death.

characters.status: Laying low at his aunt's house, heavily traumatized after his brief kidnapping and subsequent DEA interrogation.

relationships.description: Walter treats Jesse as a foolish son requiring constant discipline, yet they share a deep, complex bond of loyalty.

characters.name: Hank Schrader
characters.role: A highly competent DEA Agent, supervisor of investigations, and Walter White's brother-in-law.

goals.text: Identify and apprehend the mysterious meth kingpin known to the DEA as Heisenberg.

known_facts.text: He recently shot and killed the cartel enforcer Tuco Salamanca in a desert shootout.
He brews his own line of beer called Schraderbrau as a personal hobby.

characters.status: Investigating Walter's strange disappearance while tracking the remaining threads of Tuco Salamanca's operation.

relationships.description: Hank is Walter's brother-in-law, fiercely protective of him and his family, but entirely unaware that Walter is the drug lord he is hunting.

factions.name: Drug Enforcement Administration
factions.description: The federal law enforcement agency tasked with dismantling the drug trade in Albuquerque, currently highly focused on the new blue meth on the streets.

factions.name: The Heisenberg Operation
factions.description: The secret alliance between chemistry teacher Walter White and small-time dealer Jesse Pinkman to manufacture and sell premium blue meth.

relationships.description: Walter treats Jesse as a foolish son requiring constant discipline, yet they share a deep, complex bond of loyalty.
Hank is Walter's brother-in-law, fiercely protective of him and his family, but entirely unaware that Walter is the drug lord he is hunting.
The player is the night-shift medical orderly responsible for monitoring Walter's recovery and psychiatric state.

important_conflicts.name: The Hunt for Heisenberg
important_conflicts.description: The DEA's ongoing pursuit of the high-purity blue meth distributor, which is complicated by the fact that the suspect is the lead agent's own brother-in-law.
important_conflicts.stakes: The survival and freedom of Walter's family and criminal enterprise versus a lifetime in federal prison.

player_role.title: Hospital Night Orderly
player_role.description: An overnight medical staff member at Albuquerque General Hospital who works the quiet, low-traffic shifts in the psychiatric and recovery wards.
player_role.reason_for_presence: Assigned to perform routine, hourly wellness checks on Walter White, who is currently being held under medical observation following his naked public appearance.
capabilities: Access to patient rooms and hospital supplies
Stealthy movement through the quiet hospital corridors

connections.description: A high-profile patient currently under my direct overnight care.

starting_location.rationale: The hospital is the perfect venue for a tense, self-contained interaction where Walter White is highly vulnerable, isolated from his usual allies, and forced to protect his secrets from visiting family members.

opening_conflict.title: The Hospital Slip
opening_conflict.summary: During a routine late-night check-in, the player catches Walter White fully alert, whispering frantically into a hidden burner cell phone. Before Walter can react, footsteps echo down the corridor—Hank Schrader is arriving for an unscheduled late-night family visit to check on Walt's recovery. Walter desperately needs the player to help him hide the phone and maintain his facade of a confused, semi-conscious patient.
opening_conflict.immediate_goal: Decide how to handle Walter's hidden phone and the sudden arrival of his DEA brother-in-law.
decision_options: Help Walter hide the burner phone under his mattress and tell Hank that Walter has been sleeping peacefully all night.
Subtly draw Hank's attention to the hidden phone, exposing Walter's active state of mind and putting his cover at immediate risk.
Quietly confiscate the phone yourself, promising Walter you will keep his secret in exchange for future leverage or financial compensation.
opening_conflict.stakes: If Walter's faked fugue state is exposed to Hank, the DEA will immediately link him to the investigation, bringing his entire criminal enterprise to a premature end.

timeline_context.canon_cutoff: Season 2, during Walter White's hospital stay following his faked fugue state.
timeline_context.summary: Walter White and Jesse Pinkman were recently kidnapped by the volatile cartel distributor Tuco Salamanca. Hank Schrader tracked them down and killed Tuco in a shootout, but Walter and Jesse managed to escape beforehand. While Jesse returned to town, Walter stripped naked in a convenience store and claimed to have entered a medical fugue state to explain his multi-day absence to his wife Skyler and the authorities. Walter is currently being held in an Albuquerque hospital for evaluation.
